description_en: Updates the properties of a service instance. This operation applies only to fencing service instances
description_zh: 更新服务实例属性，目前只支持隔离服务实例
kebab_example: aliyun eas update-service-instance --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --instance-name foo-69xxxx4f4-5w9r9 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateServiceInstance

parameters.help_en: The name of the service. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名字。如何查看服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the service instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412108.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务实例的名字。如何查看实例名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412108.html
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to fence the service instance. After an instance is fenced, it is no longer managed by the VPC controller and a new instance is created. The fenced instance is reserved for troubleshooting or debugging. Note: You cannot unfence an instance. Valid values:

true: Fences the instance
parameters.help_zh:
是否隔离服务实例，实例隔离后，当前实例不再被控制器控制，会创建新的实例，被隔离的实例用于保留现场或者进行调试。注意：实例隔离后，不能接触隔离。取值如下：
true：表示隔离实例
parameters.name: detach

parameters.help_en: This parameter is for an invitational preview. It is not generally available
parameters.help_zh: 该参数正在邀测中，暂不支持使用
parameters.name: hibernate

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to isolate the instance. Valid values:

true: The instance is isolated and does not receive traffic.

false: The instance is not isolated and receives traffic
parameters.help_zh:
是否承接流量。取值如下：
true：表示承接流量。
false：表示不承接流量
parameters.name: isolate

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the instance is a replica
parameters.help_zh: 当前实例是否是实例单元
parameters.name: is_replica

Message.description_en: A message that indicates a successful operation
Message.example: instance xxxx isolation updated to true。
